title: LTT sealed aggregate challenge scoring key

dependency_cluster_id.description: Authority-derived HMAC pseudonym for the private dependency cluster; never the raw execution-registry identifier.

$comment: The executable validator additionally enforces that outcome counts sum to trial_count, slot coverage is exact, and one HMAC-pseudonymized dependency cluster is used per target. The authority derives route-consistent labels after parsing by comparing the terminal marker with semantic_solution- and surface_cue-encoded expected finals. A heldout key remains evaluator-only; a development key may reach one isolated fold worker only after raw registry identities are removed.
